title: Surrender Values Computation Sheet: Net Cash Surrender Value of Whole Life Insurance
content:
On the full surrender of an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the owner is paid the net cash surrender value.

## Formal statement

1. **Effective date.** The date the signed surrender request was received.
2. **Gross cash value.** The guaranteed cash value and the paid-up additions cash value from the most recent anniversary statement, plus the dividend accumulation balance shown on the policy, plus simple interest on that balance at the tier's dividend accumulation rate for the actual calendar days from the most recent anniversary to the surrender effective date, over **365**, that interest rounded half up to the cent.
3. **Taxable amount and withholding.** The taxable amount is the gross cash value less the cost basis shown on the policy, never below zero. Federal withholding is the tier's default withholding rate of the taxable amount, rounded half up to the cent, unless the owner elected no withholding on the surrender request, in which case it is nothing.
4. **Loan indebtedness, settled inside the surrender payment.**
   - Loan interest start: the date of the latest loan repayment on the policy ledger where that repayment paid loan interest and is later than the loan interest paid-to date shown; otherwise that paid-to date. Where the policy shows no loan interest paid-to date, interest runs from the surrender effective date, so none accrues.
   - Principal owed: the loan principal as the policy ledger totals it (loan advances and capitalized interest, less the principal repaid and extinguished, being the amounts on the loan repayment and loan offset entries), less the latest capitalization entry where its anniversary is later than the loan interest start, because interest after that start is charged here instead and is never charged twice.
   - Interest: the principal owed multiplied by the tier's loan interest rate, simple, for the actual calendar days from the loan interest start to the surrender effective date, over 365, rounded half up to the cent.
   - The loan indebtedness is the principal owed plus that interest.
5. **Net cash surrender value.** The gross cash value less the loan indebtedness, less the withholding, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Worked sheet (hypothetical Paid-Up at 100 policy; accumulation rate 3.75%, loan interest rate 6%, withholding 10%)

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Signed request received (effective date) | July 10, 2025 |
| Guaranteed cash value; additions cash value; accumulation balance | 40000.00; 6000.00; 5000.00 |
| Accumulation interest: 5000.00 times 0.0375 times 131 days (March 1 to July 10, 2025), over 365 | 67.29 |
| Gross cash value | 51067.29 |
| Cost basis; taxable amount; withholding | 35000.00; 16067.29; 1606.73 |
| Ledger loan principal (advances 11400.00, capitalization entry of 600.00 for the anniversary March 1, 2025) | 12000.00 |
| Loan interest paid-to date shown; no repayment on the ledger; loan interest start | March 1, 2024 |
| Principal owed: the capitalization anniversary is later than the start, so 12000.00 less 600.00 | 11400.00 |
| Loan interest: 11400.00 times 0.06 times 496 days, over 365 | 929.49 |
| Net cash surrender value: 51067.29 less 11400.00 less 929.49 less 1606.73 | 37131.07 |
